 Crews respond to apartment fire in Greenville County 
 The Boiling Springs Fire District is responding to a fire at an apartment complex in Greenville County Wednesday night. By Tyler Scott Published : Nov. 4, 2026 at 9:55 PM EST | Updated : 6 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google GREENVILLE, S.C. (FOX Carolina) - The Boiling Springs Fire District responded to a fire at an apartment complex in Greenville County Wednesday night.
 Officials said crews were called to respond to Huntington Downs Apartments.
 The cause of the fire is unknown at this time.
 The Greenville County Coroner’s Office said it has not been called to respond.
